senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="Q00074"><he>פָּגַם</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="Q00046"><he>פָּגוּם</he> I</cite>, a.
units: Gen. R. s. 20, quoted bel.; πήγανον would seem to be of Semitic origin) the herb rue.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שהם דומים לפ׳ וכ׳</he> resembling the leaves of rue, wide below and narrow on top, v. <cite ref="A00842"><he>אוֹר</he> II</cite>, 3.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:8">Kil. I, 8</cite> <he>אין מרכיבין פ׳ ע״ג קדה וכ׳</he> you must not graft rue on wild cassia, because it would be a combination of an herb with a tree; <cite ref="Eruvin 34b:12">Erub. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>פגם</he> (some ed. <he>פי׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200).
